svg.text: PARENTCONNECT — Parent ERD: Verification, Recovery, and Login Protection
Guardian sign-up verification, password reset OTPs, and hashed rate-limit and lockout guards
PK primary key UQ unique field ● required ○ nullable
Rate-limit and lockout rows store one-way subject hashes, not parent IDs, so they intentionally have no relationship connector. Reset and verification OTPs use declared FKs.
Every connector uses a private route and endpoint; no shared segments or T-junctions are used.
